note: Lassen Volcanic NP campground at 6,700 ft on the main park road, on the north side of small Summit Lake, with swimming from the north shore and a trail along the east shore to Summit Lake South (no RVs there). Two loops (A/B) with bear lockers at every site; close to the Lassen Peak and Cluster Lakes trailheads. --Claude
